newsitem.title: UK: Stg rally hurting UK exporters - BOE's George.
newsitem.headline: Stg rally hurting UK exporters - BOE's George.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Thursday sterling's recent appreciation was hurting Britain's exporting companies. Asked by the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee if he believed exporters' complaints that the pound's rally was beginning to hurt them, he said, "I'm sure that it is eating into profit margins or making prices less attractive than they were."
He said one of the reasons why the dollar and the pound had appreciated against European currencies was the policy mix issue.

"We have said we expect to see some rise in interest rates here at some point...that could be a factor which could actually influence our exchange rates in relation to Europe in an upwards direction," he said.
He added, "I doubt whether short-term interest rates are going to go down very much further (in Europe) if at all next year when those economies start to pick up."
